_instructions.SIL_SONRA_DON: Asagidaki bos alanlari INGILIZCE doldur, sonra bu _instructions nesnesinin TAMAMINI sil. Sadece gecerli JSON dondur. Markdown kod blogu veya aciklama yazma.

language.why: MiniMax H3 still + video prompts must be English. Turkish/other languages in visual fields hurt quality.
write_in_english: setup.look, camera, palette, lighting, era, style
characters[].notes, voice, trigger (names may stay as proper nouns)
sections: title, location, character, action, camera, visual_style, audio, music, important, logline
language.dialogue_exception: dialogue may stay in the spoken story language (set dialogue_lang: tr|en|ar|…). Everything else = English.

_instructions.what_this_is: Text-only film package for MiniMax H3 Studio. Import fills cards. Studio generates stills and videos — you do NOT create images or image URLs.

defaults.total_runtime: 12 clips x 5s = 60s (1 minute). Keep exactly 12 sections unless the user asks otherwise. 3 acts = 36 sections (3 x 12).
defaults.quality_note: Leave quality/steps as-is. Studio Produce uses the user's Draft/Final preset.

mode_field.t2v: NEW video — fresh clip (text-to-video / new beat). Use for shot 1 and for hard cuts (new location, time jump, different cast with no overlap).
mode_field.continue: CONTINUE from previous clip last frame (chain). Use when the same beat continues in the same space with overlapping cast.
mode_field.default_in_this_template: section[0]=t2v, sections[1..11]=continue for one continuous minute. Change a later section to t2v for a hard cut.

how_pipeline_works: 1) YOU write text only, IN ENGLISH: unique names + appearance notes for characters, then creatures, then locations. Same spelling in section.character / section.location.
2) Fill sections IN ENGLISH: each item is ONE 5s clip — concrete visible action, not themes. No image files.
3) User imports JSON. Cards sit ready. Nothing generates yet.
4) User clicks Produce. Studio order: character stills → creature stills → location stills (name + notes, same as Görsel oluştur), then scene videos with the selected preset (Draft or Final).
5) t2v = new clip; continue = last frame of previous clip. Studio may force t2v if cast does not overlap.

field_guide.title: Short section title (optional).
field_guide.location: Place name — must match a locations[].name when possible.
field_guide.character: Who is on screen — match characters[].name (comma-separate if multiple).
field_guide.action: ENGLISH. What happens THIS 5s clip only. Visual, specific, present tense.
field_guide.dialogue: Spoken lines in THIS clip only. Empty if silent. May stay in the story language; set dialogue_lang. Do not force a language unless the story needs it.
field_guide.dialogue_lang: auto | tr | en | ar | … — language of dialogue; auto keeps text as written.
field_guide.camera: ENGLISH. Shot size / move (e.g. medium close-up slow push-in).
field_guide.visual_style: ENGLISH. Look for THIS clip if it differs from setup; else leave empty to inherit.
field_guide.audio: ENGLISH. Diegetic sound in the clip (room tone, footsteps, rain).
field_guide.important: Must-lock details (costume, prop, continuity). Keep short.

cast_guide.characters: name + ENGLISH notes ONLY (appearance, age, wardrobe — this is the still prompt). Optional English voice tag. trigger = same as name. Leave lora_id empty. Do NOT add image/url fields.
cast_guide.locations: name + ENGLISH notes (architecture, time of day, weather). Notes become the location still prompt.
cast_guide.creatures: name + ENGLISH notes (anatomy, scale, color). Notes become the creature still prompt. No voice/lora.

setup_guide.look_camera_palette_lighting_era: Global film bible IN ENGLISH; use auto if unsure.

rules: Write ALL visual/prompt fields in English (H3 requirement). Dialogue may stay in the spoken language.
Keep exactly 12 sections unless user requests a different length
TEXT ONLY — no images, no URLs, no base64, no portrait files. Studio creates stills from name+notes.
Do not nest commentary inside sections — use the fields only
Same character name spelling everywhere (cast + sections)
Each section = one 5s beat; do not cram a whole minute into one section
